tasks.title: DShot frame CRC
tasks.statement: DShot throttle **{thr}**, telemetry bit 0. Compute the 4-bit CRC: v = throttle·2 + telemetry, CRC = (v ⊕ v>>4 ⊕ v>>8) & 0xF. The answer is a decimal number 0–15.

tasks.title: Internal resistance from sag
tasks.statement: With no load the pack reads **{u0} V**; at **{i} A** the voltage sagged by **{s} V**. Find the internal resistance of the pack (mΩ).
